fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html: metadata from the page's single NewsArticle-type ld+json block, full text from the #article_node_id HTML element since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-html-listing, homepage-scraped since no usable English-language RSS/sitemap exists) carry title/link/articleId-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-html-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json NewsArticle/OpinionNewsArticle block.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article summary/lede, from the ld+json block.

about.title: About
about.description: Raw 'about' field from ld+json, present only on some opinion pieces -- observed to just be the headline auto-split on a comma, not curated topic tags. Null on most articles.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, collected from every

tag inside the page's #article_node_id HTML element (not present in ld+json on this site).

articleType.title: Article type
articleType.description: The ld+json node's @type value, e.g. 'NewsArticle' for regular news/business/sport pieces or 'OpinionNewsArticle' for opinion columns.

category.title: Category
category.description: Section/category name, read from the entry-category breadcrumb link in HTML (not present in ld+json).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from the ld+json author Person object -- the generic 'Asharq Al Awsat' staff/wire byline for most news, or a real named columnist for opinion pieces.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from the ld+json publisher Organization object -- always the Arabic 'الشرق الأوسط', not an English string, even on the English-edition page. Passed through as-is.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL from the ld+json image ImageObject.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode homepage-listing item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL as scraped from the homepage listing.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Numeric article/node ID parsed from the homepage's data-nid attribute. Latest-mode items are sorted newest-first by this ID descending.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
